scenes.line: AI can write a novel. It can research a trend. So why does everything it ships sound like an audit trail?
Installation. Configuration. Known limitations. That is not a story. That is a compliance checklist with a README.
Here is what nobody tells you. Nobody cares what your agents do. They care what happens to them.
So PRD agent hands you the dial. From clinical truth, all the way to electric god mode.
It knows who is holding the wallet. The solopreneur. The enterprise. The normie. Different nightmares. Different dreams.
Point it at any artifact. It extracts the claims, researches the trend, finds the position, and writes the story.
Then it ships the whole launch. Landing copy. The thread. Show H N. And a ten slide pitch deck.
One command. Any repo. Story first. Feature later. This is PRD agent.
